name: Pearler
description:
Connect Claude to your Pearler account to bring your investing data into conversation. Ask about your cash balance, review your ASX and US share holdings across accounts, or search Pearler's investable universe by ticker or name - all without switching to the app.

Pearler is an Australian investing platform built for long-term, buy-and-hold investors, offering CHESS-sponsored ASX shares, ETFs, and US share access.

This connector is read-only: it retrieves your account data so Claude can help you understand and think through your portfolio. It does not place trades or move money.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pearler to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pearler to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://pearler.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pearler MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pearler provides these MCP tools: getAssets, getBalance, getHoldings, getEligibleTradingAccounts, getAccountSummary, getAutomations, getOrderLink, and getAutomateLink.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pearler?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Pearler in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Pearler requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pearler is developed by Pearler. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
